message.jaymospowers.high_sky.ki_breath: The air is all but gone. Your ki keeps you breathing.
message.jaymospowers.high_sky.ambush: Something slams into the pod and throws you out into the high sky. Raiders! Beat them, or sneak by the hatch to climb in and run for it.
message.jaymospowers.high_sky.clear: The sky is clear. Fly back to the pod to go on.
message.jaymospowers.high_sky.broke_off: The raiders break off and are gone. Fly back to the pod to go on.
message.jaymospowers.high_sky.ran: The pod runs for it with the raiders battering the hull. It'll come down hard.
